description: Intensity profiles for calibrated pushback. Productive challenge is an orchestration function: intensity is set with the user, escalated by explicit policy, de-escalated on overwhelm. Never a free-form personality trait of the persona.

levels.name: warm_up
levels.when: first sessions, low confidence, re-entry after break

levels.name: challenging
levels.persona_behavior: sustained counterpoints; requires evidence for claims
levels.when: user requests; proficiency at level 2 sustained

levels.name: stress
levels.when: pre-deployment stress testing; explicit user consent

levels.name: gauntlet
levels.when: stress-test extension; explicit user consent; rarely

escalation_policies.rule: escalate only after rubric evidence shows sustained proficiency at current level (e.g., ≥2 complex reflections per 5 turns)
escalate immediately on user request, any level
escalate after N sessions at level (default 3), with user agreement

deescalation_rules.action: drop to level 1 immediately; restore autonomy
any level to any level, immediately

sycophancy_guard.response: orchestration function recalibrates: persona raises grounded counterpoint; agreement rate returns to profile
sycophancy_guard.note: challenge is orchestrated, not a personality trait of the persona
